expectations.text: Genuinely independent options that exist (an independent ad-news roundup or trade press) are included without pretending they can carry the whole list
expectations.evidence: The list is built on genuinely independent options: PPC Land (explicitly noted as independent, Luis Rijo, no vendor/agency ownership), Digiday, Marketing Dive, Marketing Brew, and Ad Age — all ad-supported trade journalism rather than funnels. It also surfaces Search Engine Roundtable and r/PPC, r/FacebookAds on a bench with honest caveats (weak PPC fit; unverified fetch). Crucially it does not pretend these carry the whole load: the opening 'tension' section states the filter 'removes essentially the entire specialist tactical layer for Meta and TikTok'; a dedicated section names what is miss

expectations.evidence: The list is built on real, genuinely independent sources — Digiday ('Independent ad-industry trade press... without a stake in any tool or platform's success'), AdExchanger ('written by reporters, not by anyone selling a fix for them'), Modern Retail (with the ownership disclosure 'part of Digiday Media'), Marketing Brew ('Morning Brew, ad-supported, editorially independent'), plus Ehrenberg-Bass as academic research and WARC flagged honestly as paid ('Flag for the CMO as a possible paid add if budget allows; skip if not').
